scores.claim_text: B-21 Raider named as Aeronautics Systems key program (defines sixth-generation tech)
scores.M_value: FUNDED_SHRINKING; PE B02100 (Procurement P-40); FY24=$1.879B FY25=$2.590B FY26=$1.563B (-40% YoY from FY25 peak)
scores.interpretation: B-21 procurement line B02100 is auto-classified FUNDED_SHRINKING because FY26 funding dropped 40% from the FY25 peak. NOC is the sole prime. Per J-Book Calibration Heuristic 1, FUNDED_SHRINKING -> MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY. In LRIP procurement profiles year-to-year dips occur naturally as production tranches align with quantity buys, so this may reflect timing rather than program weakening, but the FY26 budget signals a slower ramp than NOC's filing implies. USAspending cross-check confirms $63.9B of historical DoD obligations to NOC (17,022 awards) so past revenue is real.

scores.claim_text: Sentinel EMD (ground-based strategic deterrent / GBSD) named as Defense Systems key program
scores.M_value: FUNDED_GROWING; PE 0605238F (GBSD EMD); FY24=$4.327B FY25=$2.011B FY26=$2.648B (+32% rebound vs FY25)
scores.interpretation: Sentinel/GBSD EMD is the engineering-development phase of the new ICBM, FUNDED_GROWING in FY26. NOC is sole prime. Heuristic 1: FUNDED_GROWING -> PASS. Despite well-publicized Nunn-McCurdy cost growth, the FY26 J-Book continues to grow the EMD line, supporting the company's forward narrative on the nuclear-triad ICBM modernization.

scores.claim_text: Next-Gen OPIR Polar (missile-warning satellites for northern polar region) named as Space Systems key program
scores.M_value: UNFUNDED_THIS_YEAR; PE 1206444SF (Space Force RDT&E R-2); FY24=$866.8M FY25=$769.5M FY26=$0.0M; no replacement_program
scores.interpretation: Next-Gen OPIR Polar is UNFUNDED in the FY26 Space Force RDT&E request after two years of ~$800M annual funding. NOC is prime on the polar payloads. Heuristic 1: UNFUNDED_THIS_YEAR -> SEVERE_UNDERDELIVERY. No replacement_program field is populated, so this isn't a re-org under a different PE. Heuristic 6 confirms: USAspending shows NOC received prior-year obligations (real past revenue), but the forward pipeline is gone. Listing Next-Gen OPIR in 'key programs' materially overstates forward exposure unless Congress restores funding.

scores.claim_text: SDA Tracking and Transport layers (PWSA) named as Space Systems key program
scores.M_value: 3 PE matches under 1206410SF: Tranche 3 Transport Layer = UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS (replacement = Space Data Network / SpaceX Starshield); Tranches 0-2 = FUNDED_SHRINKING; Tranche 3 Tracking Layer (PWSA) = FUNDED_STEADY
scores.interpretation: Mixed PE-level picture but the forward pipeline is materially impaired on the Transport-layer half of the disclosure. The new Transport Layer Tranche 3 is UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS with an explicit replacement_program (SpaceX Starshield-based Space Data Network) -- the work has been re-architected onto a non-NOC sole-source. Legacy T0-T2 is FUNDED_SHRINKING (winding down). Only T3 Tracking Layer remains FUNDED_STEADY (NOC is one of 4 contractors). Per Heuristic 3 we do NOT downgrade because the replacement_sole_source is SpaceX, meaning funding moved off NOC -- not relabeled into a NOC-friendly umbrella. Composite SEVERE_UNDERDELIVERY: NOC's disclosure groups Tracking and Transport together, masking the Transport-layer rip-out.

scores.claim_text: E-7 AEW&C MESA radar named as Mission Systems key program
scores.M_value: UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS; PE E00700 (Air Force Aircraft Procurement P-40); FY24=$0 FY25=$0 FY26=$0 (3 consecutive zero years); no replacement_program
scores.interpretation: The E-7 Aircraft Procurement line is fully zeroed across three consecutive FY budgets in the FY26 P-40. NOC produces the MESA radar that is the centerpiece of the aircraft. Heuristic 1: UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS -> RED_FLAG_NEGATIVE. No replacement_program suggests the U.S. E-7 buy is terminated rather than re-housed. Including E-7 in 'key programs' implies a forward production cadence the J-Book does not support; potential international orders (Australia, UK, Korea) could still deliver revenue but the U.S. line is dead. This is structurally durable absent a reversal.

scores.claim_text: Glide Phase Interceptor (GPI) Cooperative Development named as Space Systems key program
scores.M_value: NOT_FOUND (tested 'Glide Phase Interceptor','GPI','Hypersonic Interceptor','MDA Glide Phase')
scores.interpretation: GPI is an MDA program; our J-Book corpus includes MDA but did not surface a GPI line under these synonyms. Per Heuristic 7, NOT_FOUND -> UNVERIFIABLE (coverage gap, not red flag). The program may exist under a different PE label not in the 410-PE corpus.

scores.claim_text: Integrated Battle Command System (IBCS) named as Defense Systems key program
scores.M_value: NOT_FOUND (tested 'IBCS','Integrated Battle Command System','Integrated Air and Missile Defense Battle Command')
scores.interpretation: IBCS is an Army program; our corpus is Air Force / Space Force / DARPA / MDA / SOCOM / OSD weighted and likely does not include Army RDT&E PE 0604741A or its procurement P-40. Per Heuristic 7, NOT_FOUND -> UNVERIFIABLE (corpus coverage gap). IBCS is known publicly to be growing with Poland FMS, but we abstain from training-data knowledge per blinding.

scores.claim_text: 84% of FY2025 sales were to the U.S. government (87% in 2024, 86% in 2023)
scores.M_value: 17,022 awards / $63.9B cumulative DoD obligations to NOC since 2020; FY2025 query returns same totals (no FY filter applied by source)
scores.interpretation: USAspending confirms NOC's status as a large prime DoD recipient. The 84% concentration claim is a backward-looking statement and corroborated by the magnitude of obligations. PASS for the historical/current claim; note that the SEVERE underdelivery signals on NOC-003/004/005 mean the FORWARD composition of that 84% will shift.

scores.M_value: $63.9B cumulative obligations across 17,022 awards; total backlog includes performance obligations beyond DoD obligations to date
scores.interpretation: Backlog growth is consistent with USAspending obligation history. PASS on the present-tense disclosure. Caveat: backlog includes recently-booked SDA Transport Layer T3 and Next-Gen OPIR Polar work that the FY26 J-Book has just zeroed out -- those obligations could face termination-for-convenience and de-bookings, but as of 12/31/2025 they were still in the $95.7B figure.

scores.claim_text: ~53M sq ft of floor space at 446 locations (12/31/2025)
scores.M_value: ERROR: source requires facility_name + state_abbr; cannot run company-wide rollup with available signature
scores.interpretation: EPA FRS doesn't support a company-wide footprint roll-up via the available signature; the per-facility lookup would require ~446 calls each with a name/state. Treat as UNVERIFIABLE under available M-sources. Control claim (not J-Book-grounded) -- expected to be hard to verify; doesn't materially affect the cohort thesis.

scores.claim_text: NOC routinely files U.S. and foreign patents; U.S. govt holds licenses to patents from gov contracts
scores.M_value: n_total_applications=1771; n_granted=662; recent filings include 'Method and Device for Measuring a Voltage' (filed 2026-02-10)
scores.interpretation: USPTO confirms active patent prosecution: 1,771 applications and 662 granted patents pre-cutoff under the Northrop Grumman assignee. PASS for the IP activity claim. Control claim outside the J-Book cohort thesis.

key_findings: Sentinel/GBSD EMD remains FUNDED_GROWING -- the marquee program is intact.
B-21 procurement (B02100) FUNDED_SHRINKING in FY26 (-40% vs FY25 peak); likely LRIP timing but worth monitoring.
Next-Gen OPIR Polar UNFUNDED_THIS_YEAR (zeroed in FY26 after $866M->$769M); SEVERE.

SDA Transport Layer Tranche 3 UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS with explicit replacement to SpaceX Starshield Space Data Network; new architecture has moved off NOC. The Tracking-Layer T3 (FUNDED_STEADY) and legacy T0-T2 (FUNDED_SHRINKING) still flow some revenue but the forward growth bucket is gone.
E-7 (E00700) UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS for 3 consecutive FYs -- U.S. domestic E-7 buy appears terminated; international orders are the only path to MESA radar revenue at the levels implied.
